LESSON: QUADRATIC EXPRESSIONS AND EQUATIONS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: CORE MATHEMATICS
Strand: Numbers and Algebra
Topic 1.3: Quadratic Expressions and Equations
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 14

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Quadratic Expressions and Equations, part of Numbers and Algebra in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 CORE MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How do we use equations in daily life?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. collaborate with peers to generate quadratic expressions from given statements. Those with manipulation difficulties could use appropriate assistive technology such as padded pens/pencils or be assisted by peers/learner support assistant,

2. discuss in purposive pairs or groups and come up with quadratic identities and write them on a chart. Those with speech difficulties could use augmentative and alternative communication- AAC (residual speech/ digital devices with text-to- speech application/ point/sign/write)

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. collaborate with peers to generate quadratic expressions from given statements. Those with manipulation difficulties could use appropriate assistive technology such as padded pens/pencils or be assisted by peers/learner support assistant,
2. discuss in purposive pairs or groups and come up with quadratic identities and write them on a chart. Those with speech difficulties could use augmentative and alternative communication- AAC (residual speech/ digital devices with text-to- speech application/ point/sign/write)

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Quadratic Expressions and Equations together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Critical thinking and problem-solving: as the learner interprets statements to form and solve quadratic equations to

get solutions to real-life cases.

● Communication and collaboration: as the learner discusses with peers and comes up with quadratic identities.

12

Values:
● Unity: as the learner works with others to write quadratic identities on a chart.

● Respect: as the learner works with peers to form and solve quadratic equations to get solutions to real-life cases.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Socio-economic and environmental issues - Social cohesion: as the learner works with peers to form and solve quadratic

equations to get solutions to real-life cases.

Suggested Learning Resources

Number and operation cards, mathematical tables, charts on multiplication tables/ quadratic formulae/ equations,

writing materials made of heavy gauge paper such as manila papers, multipurpose communication boards on numbers,

white boards, slant boards, book holders, head pointers, page turners, padded pen/pencil, adapted digital devices such

as calculators and computers, projectors, internet connectivity, positioning devices such as special seats with straps
